description: Finish (variant) tiers of a card. A variant is the same card in a different art edition: gameplay never changes. A variant's code is <collectionNumber>-<suffix>, e.g. SD-001-HOLO. To rename a suffix, change it here only.

shiny.description: Same scene and pose in a prismatic or gilded colourway with a glitter sheen. Cheap and generated for every card hero.

holo.description: Re-authored edition: same scene family, new ascended pose, upgraded signature items, extra magic, its own title and an animated video. One authored card per hero.
